title: Personal Checking Deposit and Payment Limits by Tier
content:
Each Personal Checking tier sets the most that can be deposited through mobile deposit in a calendar day and in any rolling 30 calendar days, the most cash that can be withdrawn at cash machines per calendar day, the most debit card purchase value authorized per calendar day, and the most that can be sent by person-to-person payment per calendar day and in any rolling 30 calendar days.

| Tier | Mobile deposit, one calendar day (USD) | Mobile deposit, rolling 30 calendar days (USD) | Cash machine withdrawals, one calendar day (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 1500.00 | 5000.00 | 500.00 |
| Student Checking | 1000.00 | 3000.00 | 400.00 |
| Everyday Checking | 3500.00 | 10000.00 | 800.00 |
| Interest Checking | 5000.00 | 15000.00 | 1000.00 |
| Premier Checking | 10000.00 | 30000.00 | 1500.00 |
| Private Client Checking | 25000.00 | 75000.00 | 2500.00 |

| Tier | Debit card purchases, one calendar day (USD) | Person-to-person payments, one calendar day (USD) | Person-to-person payments, rolling 30 calendar days (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 2500.00 | 500.00 | 2000.00 |
| Student Checking | 1500.00 | 500.00 | 2000.00 |
| Everyday Checking | 5000.00 | 2500.00 | 10000.00 |
| Interest Checking | 5000.00 | 2500.00 | 10000.00 |
| Premier Checking | 7500.00 | 5000.00 | 20000.00 |
| Private Client Checking | 15000.00 | 10000.00 | 40000.00 |

**Points of judgement.** The daily and the rolling 30-day settings bind together rather than one replacing the other: on Everyday Checking a single mobile deposit of 3500.00 is within the daily setting, and a fourth such deposit inside the same rolling 30 calendar days would carry that window above its 10000.00 setting. Student Checking is the only tier whose daily settings sit below those of Access Checking.
